setup: Wu Ming test Battle 4: the same attack into the same 2-Infantry garrison, captained by [JOE]MatiLife's Wu Ming (Shadow's Evasion Lv. 3) with [JOE]MatiBlizzard joining under a Wu Ming flag (Shadow's Evasion Lv. 2); attacker wins on turn 141 (Gatot Skill 2).

turn_inference.cadence: King's Bestowal (Gatot Skill 2) triggers each time Gatot's Infantry attacks; the attacker fields a single Infantry unit, so one trigger per turn
assumptions: Skill Details shows attacker Gatot Skill 2 (King's Bestowal) Triggered = 141.

Per the established Gatot-instrument convention (MuellerAlpaca_Gatot_v4/v5, Lab Rat, FarSeerGatot_v3) and Martin's instruction for this set, the King's Bestowal trigger count is the exact number of turns until the battle ended.

stats_capture.notes: Left (attacker) column of the Stat Bonuses panel; all 12 rows visible. Identical in every independently captured battle (Battles 1-4).

hero_skills.name: Golden Guard
hero_skills.effect: Increases Gatot's Infantry Defense by 6%/12%/18%/24%/30% at Lv 1-5; this report does not show the skill level.

hero_skills.name: King's Bestowal
hero_skills.effect: Each time Gatot's Infantry attacks, grants them a Shield equal to Attack x 6%/12%/18%/24%/30% (Lv 1-5) for 1 turn; skill level not shown. Trigger count is this battle's turn clock.

hero_skills.name: Royal Legion
hero_skills.effect: Reduces enemy Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% at Lv 1-5; skill level not shown.

stats_capture.notes: Right (defender) column; all 12 rows visible; identical to Battle 3 on every row.

hero_skills.name: Shadow's Evasion
hero_skills.effect: Reduces his Infantry's damage taken from normal attacks by 15% and from skills by 18% (tooltip Lv. 3; MatiLife's Wu Ming, garrison Infantry hero).

hero_skills.name: Crescent Uplift
hero_skills.effect: Increases damage dealt by 8% for all troops (tooltip Lv. 2; MatiLife's Wu Ming).

hero_skills.name: Elemental Resonance
hero_skills.effect: Increases skill damage dealt by 5% for all troops (tooltip Lv. 1; MatiLife's Wu Ming).

hero_skills.name: Shadow's Evasion
hero_skills.effect: Reduces Infantry damage taken from normal attacks by 10% and from skills by 12% (tooltip Lv. 2). A joiner contributes only its flag hero's Skill 1 (GAME_RULES.md s.3); joiner skills are not itemised in Skill Details.

notes: Source: E:/WOS/Screeenshots/WuMingTests.pdf, page 2, left column (slide heading 'Battle 4: 2x Wu Ming (MatiLife & MatiBlizzard)'); screens: Battle Overview, Troop Power Comparison, Stat Bonuses, Skill Details with the attacker participant card, Defender participants panel, one Wu Ming tooltip.

Battle location X:743 Y:493 (report banner). The attacker, its troops, its Stat Bonuses and the battle location are the same in all six Wu Ming battles; the defender always totals 2 Infantry, power loss -116, shown as one combined 'Lv. 9.5' icon.

Attacker troops: Troop Power Comparison shows one Infantry icon 'Lv. 10.0' x5 with a red crystal badge '2', recorded as FC2 T10 (FC-badge convention of the Alpaca 'FC1 Lv 1.0' files). FC2 is below FC3, so Crystal Shield (the first Infantry chance proc) is not unlocked.

Defender troops: wos_sim/troop_catalog.py TIER_POWER gives T9 = 50 and T10 = 66, so the only integer-tier pair with average Lv 9.5 and total power 116 is 1 T9 + 1 T10 Infantry. Battle 4's Defender panel shows the split: [JOE]MatiLife 1 troop (power -50, T9) and [JOE]MatiBlizzard 1 troop (power -66, T10).

Defender participants panel: [JOE]MatiLife - troops 1, kills 0, power -50, heroes Wu Ming (Lv. 1) + two empty slots, Infantry row kills 0 / losses 0 / injured 1 (shown '-1') / lightly injured 0 / survivors 0; [JOE]MatiBlizzard - troops 1, kills 0, power -66, heroes Wu Ming (Lv. 1) + two empty slots, same row values.
Garrison captain = [JOE]MatiLife (report header X:745 Y:494, first entry in the Defender panel, Stat Bonuses identical to MatiLife-led Battle 3). Joiner = [JOE]MatiBlizzard with Wu Ming as flag hero.

Wu Ming skills in play: the captain's (MatiLife) Wu Ming fires all three (Skill Details Triggered 1/1/1): Shadow's Evasion Lv. 3 (-15% normal / -18% skill damage taken), Crescent Uplift Lv. 2 (+8% damage dealt), Elemental Resonance Lv. 1 (+5% skill damage) - levels from Battle 3, unchanged per Martin. The joiner's (MatiBlizzard) Wu Ming contributes only Skill 1 (GAME_RULES.md s.3): Shadow's Evasion Lv. 2 (-10% normal / -12% skill damage taken; tooltip on this slide). Joiner skills are not itemised in Skill Details.
Gatot Skill 2 = 141 (Skill 1 = 1, Skill 3 = 1): the battle ended on turn 141.

Impact vs Battle 3 (130 turns): +11 turns (x1.085). Stat Bonuses are identical on all 24 values and the troops are the same, so this is the cleanest single-variable comparison in the set: adding MatiBlizzard's joiner Wu Ming (Shadow's Evasion Lv. 2). Vs control Battle 1 (69): +72 turns (x2.043).
Battle 5 repeats this setup with the joiner's Shadow's Evasion at Lv. 3: 146 turns (+5, x1.035); its slide re-uses this battle's overview, Stat Bonuses and Defender-panel images.
Outcome: attacker 0 losses, 0 injured, 5 survivors; defender 0 losses, 2 injured, 0 survivors. The attacker participant card (Skill Details footer) shows kills 2 = defender losses 0 + injured 2.
Type 1 (deterministic): Infantry only, T9-T10 with at most FC2 (no Crystal procs unlocked); Gatot's and Wu Ming's skills are fixed-effect or fixed-cadence (no chance procs).
